iap.noads.d: Ad-free: removes the short ads between shifts and the banner. Optional rewards come without videos, with the same daily limits. Permanent.
iap.premium.d: Ad-free, plus the 3-shift forecast, 3 extra city slots and the gold theme: gold control room and gold truck livery. Permanent.
iap.speed.d: Adds 4× speed to live shifts and an optional auto-collect for the shift report. Changes time only. Permanent.
iap.dispatcher.d: Build the auto-baseload, auto-battery and auto-crew helpers early instead of in chapters 3 to 5. Same helpers, sooner. Permanent.
iap.forecast_plus.d: See the weather and events 3 shifts ahead instead of 1. Permanent.
iap.offline_plus.d: While you are away the night crew works up to 16 hours instead of 8 and earns 1.5× as much. Permanent.
iap.slots.d: 3 more city slots: run up to 4 cities side by side and switch between them in Settings. Permanent.
iap.livery_sunset.d: Paints your repair trucks in warm sunset orange and red. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.livery_arctic.d: Paints your repair trucks in icy white and blue. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.pylons_deco.d: Gives every power line pylon red and white Art Deco bands. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.blades_candy.d: Red and white striped tips on every wind turbine. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.skyline_neon.d: City windows glow in neon pink and cyan at night. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.room_retro.d: A warm retro colour scheme for the control-room screens. Looks only. Permanent.
iap.cosmetics_all.d: All six looks: Sunset and Arctic liveries, Art Deco pylons, candy turbines, neon skyline and the retro control room. Permanent.
iap.grid_pass.d: Ad-free, plus 3 extra city slots and the neon skyline windows. Permanent.
iap.bundle.d: Everything permanent in one pack: ad-free, gold theme, 4× speed, Dispatcher Assistant, long forecast, Night Crew+, extra slots and all six looks.
iap.starter.d: The Long-Range Forecast plus the Sunset truck livery, at a starter price. One-time offer. Permanent.
iap.cash_s.d: Adds 1 day of your current income to the city budget at once. Added once on this device, never restored.
iap.cash_m.d: Adds 2.5 days of your current income to the city budget at once. Added once on this device, never restored.
iap.cash_l.d: Adds 5 days of your current income to the city budget at once. Added once on this device, never restored.
iap.cash_xl.d: Adds 10 days of your current income to the city budget at once. Added once on this device, never restored.
iap.comeback.d: 1 day of your current income to restart the city after a break. Added once on this device, never restored.
iap.storm_kit.d: 3 days of your current income to rebuild after a hard storm shift. Added once on this device, never restored.
shop.policy.t: Play the whole game without paying
shop.policy.b: Tap to see how purchases work
shop.policy.full: Every district, plant and chapter is earned by playing. Purchases are optional extras. Only Remove Ads and the big packs end the ads between shifts. Budget packs are added once and are not restored. Prices come from Google Play.
shop.failed: The purchase did not go through. Try again later.
shop.unavailable: The store is not available right now.
look.theme_gold.d: Gold screens and a gold truck livery
reward.offline.b: Watch a short video to double it.
reward.bonus.b: Watch a short video for half the profit again.
reward.import.b: 60 s of power from the neighbouring grid. Watch a short video.
reward.overtime.b: Fix this fault right now. Watch a short video.
reward.unavailable: No video right now. Try again later.
settings.auto_collect_sub: Rush Hour Speed: collects the shift report by itself
city.locked: Extra City Slots in the shop
